title: Science year map template
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Seeded from science/y4 lesson 34 (Science year map template (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 34: Our science year so far: review. To understand how this year's science topics link together

questions.q: Link water and sound in one sentence.
questions.a: Sound can travel through water, so whales hear each other far away.
questions.model: Pick one fact from each topic and join them: water is a liquid; sound travels through liquids. 'Sound travels through water, so whales can hear each other.'

questions.q: Name the four changes of state we learnt.
Name one adaptation of a fish.
questions.a: Gills, fins or a streamlined shape

questions.q: Make a one-page science year map: one box each for states of matter, sound and habitats, with three facts in each.
questions.model: Teacher fills the states of matter box: 'solids keep their shape; ice melts at 0°C; evaporation makes the water cycle work'.

questions.q: Draw two lines linking facts in different boxes and explain each link.
questions.a: For example: water cycle links to ocean habitats

questions.q: Write three quiz questions, one from each topic, with answers.
Which topic do I most need to revise?
Big question: what do the oceans link to in our year?
questions.a: The water cycle, sound in water, habitats and food chains.
